text:
Andrea: Observed KV-cache memory growing without bound on long-context runs (~50k tokens). Repro on H100 and MI250x but only MI250x shows an eviction "snowball" where free pages trend to 0. Profiling traces attached.
Sam: @Andrea can you paste the slab/pagetable dump? suspect a pt straddle / alignment issue like we saw earlier.
Andrea: dump excerpt:
```
pg_idx=81234 addr=0x7f9a3c000 owner=GPU1 flags=STRADDLE len=8192 ref=0
pg_idx=81235 addr=0x7f9a3e000 owner=GPU1 flags=CONTIG len=4096 ref=2
pg_idx=81236 addr=0x7f9a3f000 owner=GPU2 flags=STRADDLE len=4096 ref=0
```
We see STRADDLE entries interleaved with CONTIG ones; evict keeps failing and we hit reclamation stalls.
Jules: "STRADDLE" flag? we didn't intentionally tag pages like that. Sounds like allocator suballoc + different page-size causing a split mapping.
Li: On H100 our coalescer coalesces adjacents aggressively; MI250x returns non-contiguous host pages to the GPU which can break the coalesce heuristic and yield "straddles". That matches the architecture difference.
Mason: Can you share the repro steps / microbench? @Andrea
Andrea: repro: `longctx_repro.py --model tiny --tokens 50000 --device mi250x --profile kvcache --iters 3`
Log snippet:
```
evict: want=4 free=1 trying idx=123 owner=0x7ffd1a
reclaim: qemu_fence_wait failed -> stall
evict: failed, enqueue delayed_reclaim
kvcache: growth +2048 bytes (len=8192) total=1.2GB
```
This loops for ~minutes until memory climbs.
infra-bot: rollout r-ht-112 (allocator tweak) reverted on mi250x pool at 2024-11-02T09:23Z.
Sam: Short-term mitigations: (A) force pt-mapper to prefer contiguous ranges (avoid splitting), (B) pin a small reserved contiguous pool for large KV pages, (C) fallback to per-GPU single-page allocations when STRADDLE rate exceeds threshold.
Jules: Also noticed we shipped a kernel selection tweak (pagedattn v2) that increases KV tile_size from 64->128; larger tiles increase probability of crossing page boundaries and creating straddles. Might be two independent factors colliding.
Li: Can someone run the KV tile_size toggle microbench on both devices? I suspect threshold ~96 triggers the MI path.
Andrea: I did: tile_size=64 -> stable, tile_size>=96 -> steady mem growth on MI250x. Perf counters show: `TLB_MISS++`, `PCI_WRITE_STALL++`, and `PT_MAP_SPLIT++`.
Mason: Good repro signal. Proposed immediate plan:
  - revert the kernel tile_size bump on MI250x (Jules)
  - add assert/logging in pt mapper to refuse creating STRADDLE mappings and instead fallback to per-page mappings (Jules)
  - add telemetry to Console: straddle_rate per node and per model route (Sam)
  - longer term: improve allocator coalesce policy for MI pages (Li + eng-infra)
Sam: I'll open TRACKER-8342 and assign tags: eng-runtime, eng-infra, regression, mi250x.
Jules: I'll own the revert + small patch to mapper today, will PR by EOD.
Andrea: posting heap trace attachments once I have two more runs (tile_size=128 and tile_size=64) and will include `nvprof`/rocprof counters.
Sam: Thanks. If anyone sees similar on other cards (A100/H100) please ping here.
Jules: quick note: if we see `PT_MAP_SPLIT` spikes > 0.5% we should auto-fallback kernels in the serving router.
Andrea: will add traces. Thanks all :thumbsup:
